description: This line plot illustrates the "Mean Interclass Similarity" across 64 steps (x-axis, ranging from 0 to 64 with integer tick marks) for three different experimental conditions in relation extraction: "w/o DPO obo" (blue solid line with circle markers), "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (orange solid line with triangle markers), and "DPO" (green solid line with square markers). Each condition also has a corresponding dashed line representing its moving average: "Average of w/o DPO obo" (blue dashed), "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (orange dashed), and "Average of DPO" (green dashed). The y-axis, labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 with major tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The blue line starts at approximately 0.22, spikes sharply to 0.48 at step 2, then drops and fluctuates between 0.05 and 0.28. The orange line begins near 0.09, rises to 0.19 at step 2, and exhibits high volatility, peaking at 0.47 at step 32 and again at 0.46 at step 60. The green line starts at 0.19, dips to 0.03 at step 6, and generally remains low, fluctuating between 0.03 and 0.18. The three dashed average lines are nearly flat: the blue average is at 0.107, the orange at 0.158, and the green at 0.086, as annotated on the plot. The orange condition consistently shows the highest mean interclass similarity, followed by blue, then green, indicating that the DPO method results in the lowest interclass similarity on average.
